responsibility: This target machine-modes definition file describes m68k-specific floating-point mode properties. It replaces the default SFmode and DFmode formats with Motorola canonical-NaN encodings and defines XFmode as the 80-bit IEEE extended format stored in a 96-bit Motorola layout. GCC’s mode generation machinery consumes this file to create the target’s floating-point mode and format definitions used throughout code generation and constant handling.
